newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: U.N. agency centres attacked in north Uganda.
newsitem.headline: U.N. agency centres attacked in north Uganda.

text.p: The United Nations refugee agency UNHCR said on Tuesday armed men had attacked its offices and staff quarters in the north Ugandan town of Pakele where it directs operations in support of Sudanese refugees.
Offices were ransacked and vehicles, a motorcycle and communications equipment were burned in the attack late on Monday, UNHCR spokesman Ron Redmond told a news briefing.

Afterwards, he said, 84 foreign and national staff of the UNHCR and other U.N. agencies and non-governmental organisations in the area were flown to the Ugandan capital, Kampala, 600 km (370 miles) to the south as a security precaution.
The attackers were not immediately identified and the motive for the assault was not known, Redmond added.

The UNHCR office in Pakele, a village near the town of Adjumani, are shared with the Geneva-based Lutheran World Federation. It takes care of about half the 229,000 Sudanese refugees in northern Uganda.
